Class Deck

java.lang.Object
library.container.CardContainer
library.container.Deck
public class Deck extends CardContainer
Uno deck, loaded based on a pair of 1-9 numbers per colour, plus one 0 card per colour, 3 pairs of action cards per colour, and 4 lots of both wild card and wild draw four cards (= 108 cards).

      Parameters:

    • drawCards

      public void drawCards(Player player, int cards, boolean forced, Game game)
      Parameters:
      player - The relevant player who will be receiving cards.
      cards - Number of cards to be picked up.
      forced - Is the player forced to receive these cards?
      game - Relevant game instance. Draws cards from the deck to the player's hand, accounting for overflow by merging the discard pile where required.

    • mergeDiscardPile

      public void mergeDiscardPile(Game game)
      Parameters:
      game - relevant game instance. Moves the cards from the discard pile into the deck, and checks the integrity of the deck to ensure there's no errors.
